_comment: Who has checked the platform's rules and engine, and when (brief 27, #254). Append a new entry to change a status; never edit or remove one. Statuses: PENDING (not yet checked), OWNER_CHECKED (checked by the owner: not a professional verification), PROFESSIONALLY_VERIFIED (verified by a qualified professional, named in 'by'). The latest entry per subject applies.

PENDING.en: The projection engine is pending independent professional review and is not certified.
PENDING.el: Εκκρεμεί ανεξάρτητος επαγγελματικός έλεγχος του μοντέλου προβολών, χωρίς πιστοποίηση.

OWNER_CHECKED.en: The projection engine was checked by the owner on {on}; it is not independently certified.
OWNER_CHECKED.el: Το μοντέλο προβολών ελέγχθηκε από τον ιδιοκτήτη στις {on}· δεν έχει πιστοποιηθεί ανεξάρτητα.

PROFESSIONALLY_VERIFIED.en: The projection engine was validated by {by} on {on}.
PROFESSIONALLY_VERIFIED.el: Το μοντέλο προβολών επικυρώθηκε από {by} στις {on}.
